2 جزّع , inf. n. تَجْزِيعٌ, It (a full-grown unripe date) became ripe to the extent of two thirds of it: (S:) or to the extent of half of it; (K, TA;) from the bottom: (TA:) or became partly ripe: and in like manner one says of a grape. (TA.) ―
-b2- It (a watering-trough, or tank,) had but little remaining in it. (K, * TA.) ―
-b3- He put a little water into a skin. (TA.) ＝
-A2- جزّع فُلَانًا, (K,) inf. n. as above, (TA,) He caused the impatience (جَزَع) of such a one to cease: (K:) he said to him that which comforted him, or consoled him, and which caused his grief and fear to cease. (IAth.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
